# Percona Server for MongoDB 8.3

> Percona Server for MongoDB 8.3, a source available drop-in replacement for MongoDB 8.3 Community Edition with added features, with installation, upgrade, security, backup and operations guides

Each page below is also available as markdown. For the documentation of all Percona products, see https://docs.percona.com/llms.txt.

## Overview

- [Home](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/index.md): Percona Server for MongoDB is an enhanced, fully compatible, source available, drop-in replacement for MongoDB 8.3 Community Edition with enterprise-grade features.
- [Get help from Percona](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/get-help.md): Our documentation guides are packed with information, but they can’t cover everything you need to know about Percona Server for MongoDB. They also won’t cover every scenario you might come across.…
- [FAQ](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/faq.md)
- [Percona Software and Platform Lifecycle](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/lifecycle.md): See the Percona Release Lifecycle Overview for information about support and platform end-of-life dates

## Get started

- [Quickstart guides](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/index.md): Percona Server for MongoDB is an enhanced, fully compatible, source available, drop-in replacement for MongoDB 8.3 Community Edition with enterprise-grade features.
- [Infrastructure requirements: System requirements](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/system-requirements.md)
- [Virtual hardware recommendations for cloud deployments](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/cloud-deployments.md): Percona Server for MongoDB runs reliably on cloud infrastructure and is supported for all cloud providers.
- [1. Install: On Debian and Ubuntu](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/apt.md): This document describes how to install Percona Server for MongoDB from Percona repositories on DEB-based distributions such as Debian and Ubuntu.
- [1. We gather Telemetry data to understand the…
- [1. Install: On Rocky Linux](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/rocky-linux.md): This guide walks you through the installation of Percona Server for MongoDB on Rocky Linux.
- [1. Install: On Amazon Linux 2023](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/amazon-linux.md): This guide walks you through the installation of Percona Server for MongoDB on Amazon Linux 2023.
- [1. Install: From tarballs](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/tarball.md): You can find links to the binary tarballs under the Generic Linux menu item on the Percona website
- [Build from source code](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/source.md): This document guides you though the steps how to build Percona Server for MongoDB from source code.
- [1. Install: Run in Docker](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/install/docker.md): Docker images of Percona Server for MongoDB are hosted publicly on Docker Hub.
- [2. Connect to Percona Server for MongoDB](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/connect.md): After you have successfully installed and started Percona Server for MongoDB, let’s connect to it.
- [3. Manipulate data in Percona Server for MongoDB](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/crud.md): After you connected to Percona Server for MongoDB, let’s insert some data and operate with it.
- [4. What's next?](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/what-next.md): Congratulations on completing your first hands-on experience with Percona Server for MongoDB.

## Features

- [Feature comparison with MongoDB](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/comparison.md): Percona Server for MongoDB 8.3 is based on MongoDB Community Edition 8.3 and extends it with the functionality, that is otherwise only available in MongoDB Enterprise Edition.
- [Storage: Percona Memory Engine](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/inmemory.md): Percona Memory Engine is a special configuration of WiredTiger that does not store user data on disk. Data fully resides in the main memory, making processing much faster and smoother. Keep in mind…
- [Backup: Hot Backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/hot-backup.md): Percona Server for MongoDB includes an integrated open source hot backup system for the default WiredTiger storage engine. It creates a physical data backup on a running server without notable…
- [$backupCursor and $backupCursorExtend aggregation stages](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/backup-cursor.md): $backupCursor and $backupCursorExtend aggregation stages expose the WiredTiger API which allows making consistent backups. Running these stages allows listing and freezing the files so you can copy…
- [Authentication: Authentication overview](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/authentication.md): Authentication is the process of verifying a client’s identity. Normally, a client needs to authenticate themselves against the MongoDB server user database before doing any work or reading any data…
- [Authentication: AWS IAM: AWS IAM authentication](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/aws-iam.md): IAM (Identity Access Management) is the AWS service that allows you to securely control access to AWS resources. Percona Server for MongoDB supports authentication with AWS IAM enabling you to use…
- [Setting up AWS IAM authentication](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/aws-iam-setup.md): This document provides guidelines how to configure Percona Server for MongoDB to use AWS IAM authentication. The use of this authentication method enables you to natively integrate Percona Server for…
- [Setting up Kerberos authentication](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/kerberos.md): This document provides configuration steps for setting up Kerberos Authentication in Percona Server for MongoDB.
- [Authentication: LDAP: LDAP authorization](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/authorization.md): LDAP authorization allows you to control user access and operations in your database environment using the centralized user management storage – an LDAP server. You create and manage user credentials…
- [Set up LDAP authentication with SASL](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/sasl-auth.md): This document describes an example configuration suitable only to test out the external authentication functionality in a non-production environment. Use common sense to adapt these guidelines to…
- [Set up x.509 authentication and LDAP authorization](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/x509-ldap.md): x.509 certificate authentication is one of the supported authentication mechanisms in Percona Server for MongoDB. It is compatible with LDAP authorization to enable you to control user access and…
- [Set up LDAP authentication and authorization using NativeLDAP](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/ldap-setup.md): This document describes an example configuration of LDAP authentication and authorization using direct binding to an LDAP server (Native LDAP). We recommend testing this setup in a non-production…
- [LDAP configuration parameters](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/ldap-parameters.md): Percona Server for MongoDB provides a set of configuration parameters to enable and fine-tune LDAP authentication and authorization.
- [Authentication: OIDC: OIDC authentication](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/oidc.md): OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an identity authentication protocol built on top of the OAuth 2.0 framework. OIDC is designed to verify user identities and provide authentication, ensuring that users are…
- [Authentication: OIDC: Configure OIDC authentication: With Okta](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/oidc-okta.md): This document focuses on configuring OIDC authentication for Percona Server for MongoDB deployment using Okta as the identity provider.
- [Authentication: OIDC: Configure OIDC authentication: With Microsoft Entra](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/oidc-entra.md): This document provides step-by-step instructions how to configure OIDC authentication and authorization the Percona Server for MongoDB using Microsoft Entra as an external identity provider.
- [Authentication: OIDC: Configure OIDC authentication: With Ping Identity](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/oidc-ping.md): This document provides step-by-step instructions how to configure OIDC authentication and authorization the Percona Server for MongoDB using Ping Identity as an external identity provider.
- [Authentication: OIDC: Configure OIDC authentication: With Keycloak](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/oidc-keycloak.md): This document focuses on configuring OIDC authentication for Percona Server for MongoDB deployment using Keycloak as the identity provider.
- [Authentication: OIDC: Configure OIDC authentication: OIDC authentication and LDAP authorization](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/oidc-ldap.md): You can use OIDC authentication and LDAP authorization together. This guide also applies to migration to OpenBao - an open-source alternative to HashiCorp Vault.

- [File copy based initial sync](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/fcbis.md): The file copy-based initial sync method is a physical copying of the data files from the source to the target. It is much faster than the default logical initial sync for big datasets (500GB+), which…

- [Profiling rate limit](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/rate-limit.md): Percona Server for MongoDB can limit the number of queries collected by the database profiler to decrease its impact on performance. Rate limit is an integer between 1 and 1000 and represents the…
- [Log redaction](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/log-redaction.md): Percona Server for MongoDB can prevent writing sensitive data to the diagnostic log by redacting messages of events before they are logged.
- [Additional text search algorithm - ngram](https://docs.percona.com/percona-server-for-mongodb/8.3/ngram-full-text-search.md): The ngram text search algorithm is useful for searching text for a specific string of characters in a field of a collection.
